plan_a_advantages: Includes a dedicated threshold workout for strength development.
Features a longer, trail-specific endurance run.
Incorporates cross-training for varied movement and recovery.
plan_b_advantages: More consistent aerobic volume with longer runs.
Tempo run is included, providing a structured speed workout.
reasoning: Plan A is the better training plan for a trail runner aiming to become faster. It incorporates a dedicated threshold workout, crucial for building the sustainable strength needed for sustained pace on trails, alongside a longer, more trail-specific endurance run. Plan B, while including a tempo run, relies heavily on consistent, longer aerobic runs which, while beneficial, don't directly target the speed improvements desired. The inclusion of a cross-training session in Plan A also provides a valuable opportunity for varied movement and recovery, complementing the other workouts.  Ultimately, Plan A’s focus on both strength and targeted endurance is more directly aligned with the goal of becoming a faster trail runner.
